1.title: 1. Psychological screening
1.body: You'll chat with the AI mascot through a short DASS-21 test. The result accurately measures your current levels of Stress, Anxiety and Depression.
1.note: * You'll need to log in with some basic information so the system can make the most accurate recommendations.

2.title: 2. Build your playlist
2.body: The system applies the ISO principle: it starts with songs whose rhythm matches your sadness, then gradually raises the tempo and energy to lift your mood.

3.title: 3. Listen & Release
3.body: Immerse yourself in a personalized music space. You can listen while writing an emotion diary and chatting with an AI chatbot designed to be your companion.

4.title: 4. Track your progress
4.body: Visit your profile to follow your healing journey, from DASS-21 emotion charts to an analysis of the music genres you've listened to.

consent.title: Agree to the terms
consent.subtitle: MindMelody - AI mental wellbeing support system

s1.title: 1. Research purpose
s1.body: This system is the product of a scientific research project. We use music and AI (following the ISO Principle) to help students regulate their emotions. Your data helps us evaluate the effectiveness of the algorithm.

s2.title: 2. Data we collect
s2.item1: Psychological scores from the DASS-21 test.
s2.item3: Your conversations with the AI assistant (encrypted).

s3.title: 3. Security & Privacy commitment
s3.body: All of your personal data is encrypted. Your real identity is not used in scientific reports. We commit not to share this data with any third party outside the purpose of the research.

s4.title: 4. Safety rules (SOS)
s4.body: Note: MindMelody is an emotional support assistant, not a medical doctor or a licensed psychologist. If the system detects signs of a risk of self-harm, we will automatically activate emergency support mode and provide official medical contact information.

consent.agree: I have read and understood the terms and agree to provide my data for research purposes.

footer.description: A personalized music recommendation system that supports emotion regulation based on psychological state and the ISO Principle.
